title: Kusanagi Nene — The Confidence You Gave Me〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hi, Kusanagi.
Thanks for coming.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sure...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This girl means a lot to... Your friend.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Conversely, you may want to think about what exactly you want to do instead of how she feels...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi... I understand why someone in that position would hesitate the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But if you do nothing while they remain lost... Who might feel the worst in the end?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I should thank Hoshino giving me that advice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... About that friend I told you about the other day, she seems much better now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, really...? Hehe. I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and thank you for that advice you gave me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm really glad I asked you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you're very welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been helping me with my singing like this, so I'm glad that I was able to give back a little.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, her voice sounds much more stable through that section now. She's even breathing and controlling her volume better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's going into the chorus much smoother too. She must've practiced a lot...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Phew... How was that?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was good.
All that's left are the finer details, like making sure your state of mind matches the lyrics you're singing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like how I feel when I'm singing? Okay, I'll try working on that for next time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Great.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I have a feeling that you're not singing as well as you usually can... Maybe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If you sing more normally, it might actually sound better... I guess...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (When I was teaching them what to do, I just thought about practicing with Hoshino and managed to get through to them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But was that really the right way to put it? They might've been able to sing better if I actually knew what to say then...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Is something the matter, Kusanagi...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, no! It's nothing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But... You have a lot of fond memories of Phoenix Wonderland too, right, Hoshino...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I do. Saki, my friends and I used to go there often when we were kids. My family too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's nice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about you, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me? Um... I never had a chance to go because I was in a children's theatre company...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I think Emu's right. It sounds like a lot of people really do care about Phoenix Wonderland...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (For the sake of the park and all of its fans, our next show has to succeed.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But can that really happen with me having to tell so many people what to do...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyways, shall we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uh, wait! There's one thing I need to ask you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: D-Does the way I teach make it hard for you to understand stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thing is... I have to teach people from Phoenix Wonderland's other troupes how to sing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?! That's great, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I'm not sure it is...
I'm so worried that I'm not doing a good job...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sorry if this is too sudden. I get that it's my own problem and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No.
But I see...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I really like the way you teach. Every piece of advice you've given me has been spot on so far.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You make everything so easy to learn by explaining how to sing which kinds of songs and even singing along to help me understand it better.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I am proof that what you do works!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that's because you have such a good work ethic...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you've even talked about how I should be practicing and what to look out for. You did all of that, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're the reason why I've been able to try so hard and really believe in myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So you should believe in what you're doing too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're willing to say that much, maybe I should have more confidence in myself...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you should...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Hoshino.
You got to be the teacher today for a change.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't actually mean to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I'm glad you did.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really appreciate what you said, Hoshino. I promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great! I'll be rooting for you!
